description: UAV tile oil palm crown detection dataset manifest
label_notes: Single-class detection. Future versions may add dead_palm or other_tree classes.

split_strategy.constraint: All tiles from the same UAV mission must stay in the same split
split_strategy.notes: Adjacent tiles have spatial overlap; splitting by mission prevents data leakage

notes: raw layer accepts COCO, Pascal VOC, or custom annotation formats
importers convert to unified YOLO format in processed/yolo layer
Tile size and overlap should be documented per source
